D/ CONSTAN S PF AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), mint of Rome, Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, RIC vol. 8 no. 101. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories standing facing each other holding wreaths aloft. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: R.[club]O. Diameter: 15.1mm,…
